# Cover

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Combat > Attacks](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Cover)*

Cover provides a degree of protection to a target behind it. There are three degrees of cover, each of which provides a different benefit to a target: [Half Cover](Cover.md) (+2 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws), [Three-Quarters Cover](Cover.md) (+5 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws), and [Total Cover](Cover.md) (can't be targeted directly). If behind more than one degree of cover, a target benefits only from the most protective degree. *See also* "Playing the Game" ("[Combat](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#Cover)").
